activation_note: Release approval metadata, not a new runtime feature flag. Source push and CI are not deployment or BA sign-off.

request.auth: Existing bearer access token; no new work-shift or stable-session prerequisite.
request.headers: No new opt-in header. Confirm meta.contract on the response.

query.warehouse_id: Optional; when present must be a nonempty UUID of an existing warehouse within role scope. Send the canonical lowercase UUID: inherited scope middleware may reject noncanonical values. Omitted means full authorized scope, never implicit active warehouse.
query.date: Optional YYYY-MM-DD within existing InputLimits::date window. Null/omitted uses today in config(app.timezone). Applies only to posted_count.

request.unknown_query: 422 P02_UNKNOWN_FILTER. page/status/tenant filters are not P02 inputs.
request.nonempty_body: Rejected with 422 P02_QUERY_ONLY after existing auth/data-scope middleware.

scope.data_scope: Effective result scope AFTER warehouse filtering, not maximum role access.
scope.authorization_scope: Role access scope BEFORE warehouse filtering. Informational only; does not grant access.
scope.warehouse_id: Explicit selected warehouse UUID or null. Must equal warranty.warehouse_scope.warehouse_id when warranty is visible. Null does not mean GLOBAL for a warehouse-scoped role.

warranty.time_semantics: Current open-case snapshot; date does not filter it. COMPLETED awaits return and is included. RETURNED/CANCELLED are excluded.
warranty.ownership: warranty-owner-v1 persisted owners; EXISTS does not multiply cases. TEMP_ONLY with no item_id is included when its owner is in scope.
warranty.unassigned_policy: Excluded for an explicit warehouse or restricted role; included only for authorized GLOBAL unfiltered view, preserving owner-v1.
warranty.ownership_complete: Existing source-wide coverage flag, not a per-warehouse missing-case total. No outside-scope case IDs or counts returned.
warranty.zero: Integer 0 only after a successful authorized query confirms no matching cases. Never coerce null/errors to 0.

document_counts.pending_approval_count: Existing current SCANNING documents with at least one line and every scanned_qty equal to qty_planned. No date filtering.
document_counts.posted_count: Existing posted_at >= start of requested day AND < start of next day in application timezone. Later REVERSED documents still count.
document_counts.top_level_totals: Sum only visible inbound/outbound sections, never add warranty.open_count.

cache.stock: Existing stock_short TTL and stock:version. New miniapp:dashboard:summary:p02-v2 namespace separates old schema; filters, visibility and role warehouse scope remain in keys.
cache.consistency: Stock may be cached and warranty is a current read. NOT an atomic or frozen cross-section snapshot. Response timestamp does not claim joint data freshness.

errors.403: Missing endpoint permissions or denied warehouse scope. Inherited middleware may reject before query validation.
errors.404: WAREHOUSE_NOT_FOUND for an authorized explicit UUID that does not exist.
errors.source_failure: Non-success follows existing error handling, not empty/zero. No new source-recovery guarantee.

compatibility.replaces: P02 summary metadata/schema semantics in the earlier 06/10 handoff. Preserves endpoint, count semantics and warranty-owner-v1.
compatibility.migration: Clients treating data_scope as role scope must use authorization_scope. Read data_scope + warehouse_id for displayed KPI scope.
compatibility.p12: Recent/document list owner only. Its page length/total/cursor does not replace P02 KPIs.
